start.description:
Start datetime of the time range. The start date is inclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2010-01-01T00:00:00' (everything starting from '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

end.description:
End datetime of the time range. The end date is exclusive of the date mentioned.
E.g. '2011-01-01T00:00:00' (everything before '2011-01-01T00:00:00' will be included)

isRoot.description:
If true, returns all the root actions.
If false, returns all the child actions.
If null, returns all the actions.

queryString.description: Accepts the query in Lucene syntax

fieldsMap.description:
A map where each key is a string enum of type {@link Log.AppProfile.ActionField}, representing an action field,
and each value is a {@link Log.AppProfile.FilterFieldSpec}, defining the filter specifications associated with that action field.

title:
Defines a filter specification for profiling application logs,
combined time range constraints.
name: Log.AppProfile.FilterSpec
